blocks.text: **on** ning asosiy ma'nosi — biror narsaga **ulangan, tegib turgan, ishlayotgan**: chiroq yoniq, kiyim ustida, reja kuchda. **off** — aksincha: **uzilgan, ajralgan, uzoqlashgan**: chiroq o'chiq, kiyim yechilgan, reja bekor, odam jo'nab ketgan. Asoslar qizil kitobda: put on / take off, turn on / turn off (→ qizil kitob, 115-dars). Bu darsda to'rt soha: **texnika**, **kiyim va tashqi ko'rinish**, **rejalar** (keyinga qoldirish va bekor qilish) va **jo'nab ketish**. on ning «davom etish» ma'nosi va off ning boshqa ma'nolari — keyingi darsda (→ 141-dars).
Texnika: turn on, put on, leave on, cut off

**turn on / off** va **switch on / off** ko'pincha bir xil, lekin jo'mrak, gaz va burab ochiladigan narsalar uchun faqat **turn**: **turn on** the tap («switch on the tap» — xato). **put on** — biror narsani ishlatish uchun «qo'yib yubormoq»: **put** the kettle **on**, **put** some music **on**. **leave on** — o'chirmay qoldirmoq. **come on** / **go off** — o'zi yonmoq / o'chmoq (to'ldiruvchisiz). **cut off** — ta'minotni yoki aloqani uzmoq, ko'pincha majhulda: We were **cut off**. Holatni sifat kabi **on** / **off** bilan aytish mumkin: Is the oven **on**?

items.text: Don't **leave** your charger **on** when you go out — it wastes electricity.
items.translation: Tashqariga chiqqaningda quvvatlagichni **ulab qoldirma** — elektr behuda ketadi.

items.text: The street lights **come on** at dusk and **go off** at dawn.
items.translation: Ko'cha chiroqlari shom tushganda **yonadi**, tong otganda **o'chadi**.

items.text: Aziz **turned** the tap **off** and noticed that the pipe was leaking.
items.translation: Aziz jo'mrakni **berkitdi** va quvurdan suv sizayotganini payqadi.

blocks.text: Kiyim va tashqi ko'rinish: put on, have on, keep on

O'zbekcha «kiymoq» bir nechta inglizcha ifodaga to'g'ri keladi. **put on** — kiyish **harakati** (bir lahza): He **put on** his coat and left. **wear** va BrE so'zlashuvdagi **have on** — kiyib yurish **holati**: He's **wearing** a coat = He **has** a coat **on**. **keep on** — yechmasdan turmoq: **Keep** your hat **on**. **put on** ning boshqa ma'nolari ham bor: **put on weight** — semirmoq (aksi — lose weight), **put on** a show / an exhibition — tashkil qilmoq, sahnalashtirmoq, **put on** a brave face — o'zini tetik ko'rsatmoq, **put it on** — o'zini kasallikka yoki boshqa holatga solmoq.

rows: **put on** a show / a brave face

items.text: **Keep** your gloves **on** — your hands will freeze without them.
Jasur **has put on** a lot of weight since he started working from home.
items.translation: Jasur uydan ishlay boshlaganidan beri ancha **semirib ketdi**.

items.text: The man in the photo **has** a grey suit **on** and is holding a briefcase.
items.translation: Suratdagi odamning **egnida** kulrang kostyum **bor**, qo'lida portfel.

blocks.text: Rejalar: put off, call off, be off, go ahead

Ikki fe'l ko'p chalkashadi: **put off** — keyinga qoldirmoq (voqea **keyinroq bo'ladi**), **call off** — bekor qilmoq (voqea **umuman bo'lmaydi**). **put off** dan keyin fe'l kelsa — faqat `-ing`: put off **going** (→ 53-dars). Rejaning holatini **be on** / **be off** bilan aytish mumkin: Is the party still **on**? — Ziyofat hali ham bo'ladimi? The wedding **is off**! — To'y bekor bo'ldi! **go ahead** — rejadagidek o'tmoq. **put off** ning ikkinchi ma'nosi — **put sb off**: kimningdir xohishini so'ndirmoq, ko'nglini aynitmoq: The smell **put** me **off** my food.

rows: We **put off** the trip till May.

items.text: We had to **put off** our trip because Grandpa was taken to hospital.
items.translation: Bobomni kasalxonaga olib ketishgani uchun safarimizni **keyinga qoldirishga** majbur bo'ldik.

items.text: The match was **called off** — it won't be played this season at all.
items.translation: O'yin **bekor qilindi** — bu mavsumda umuman o'tkazilmaydi.

items.text: Is the meeting still **on**? — Yes, it's **going ahead** at three.
items.translation: Yig'ilish hali ham **bo'ladimi**? — Ha, soat uchda **o'tkaziladi**.

blocks.text: off = jo'nab ketish: set off, be off, take off

**off** — biror joydan **uzoqlashish**. **set off** — yo'lga chiqmoq (yo'nalish — **for**: set off **for** Bukhara); **be off** — ketmoq (I'm **off**! — Men ketdim!); **head off** — jo'namoq; harakat usulini fe'l bildiradi: **drive off** (haydab ketib qolmoq), **run off** (qochib ketmoq), **walk off** (turib ketib qolmoq). Samolyot uchun — **take off** (havoga ko'tarilmoq). Ish joyidan uzoqlashish: **take** a day **off** (ishdan javob olmoq), **have** a day **off** (dam olish kuni bo'lmoq), **get off** work (ishdan chiqmoq).

items.text: We **set off for** Bukhara at dawn and arrived before the heat.
items.translation: Tong saharda Buxoroga **yo'lga chiqdik** va jazirama boshlanmasdan yetib keldik.

items.text: Sorry, I can't stop and chat — I'm **off** to the airport.
Kate **took** a week **off** to finish painting her flat.
items.translation: Keyt kvartirasini bo'yab tugatish uchun bir hafta **ta'til oldi**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Open the light / Close the TV» → **turn on** the light / **turn off** the TV (→ qizil kitob, 115-dars); «Switch on the tap» → **turn on** the tap; holatni harakat bilan aytish — «In the photo he puts on a black jacket» → he's **wearing** / he **has** a black jacket **on**; «Don't put off to call him» → put off **calling** him; «The concert was put off, it won't happen» → **called off** (bo'lmasa — call off, keyinroq bo'lsa — put off); «We set off to London» → set off **for** London; «The plane flew up at nine» → The plane **took off** at nine; «put out» (olovni o'chirmoq, → 139-dars) bilan «put off» ni chalkashtirish.

Rejalar haqida gapirganda o'zingizga savol bering: «Bu voqea baribir bo'ladimi?» Ha, lekin keyinroq — **put off**; yo'q — **call off**; ha, aytilgan vaqtda — **go ahead** / **be on**. Kiyimda esa: harakatmi (bir lahza) — **put on**; holatmi — **wear** / **have on**.

Bog'lanish: on — davom etish (go on, carry on, keep on), off ning boshqa ma'nolari (drop off, see off, show off) — 141-dars; olovni o'chirish — put out (139-dars); fe'l + `-ing` (put off doing) — 53-dars; frazali fe'l turlari — 137-dars.

examples.title: Machines and lights: **turn on**, **leave on**, **come on**
examples.description: **turn on** / **off**, **switch on** / **off** — yoqmoq / o'chirmoq; **put on** — (choynak, musiqa) qo'ymoq; **leave on** — yoniq qoldirmoq; **come on** / **go off** — o'zi yonmoq / o'chmoq; **cut off** — (elektr, aloqa) uzib qo'ymoq.

sentences.text: Shall I **put the kettle on**? You look like you need a cup of tea.
sentences.translation: Choynakni **qo'yaymi**? Bir piyola choyga muhtojga o'xshaysiz.

sentences.text: Who **left** the lights **on** in the bathroom all night?
sentences.translation: Hammomdagi chiroqni tun bo'yi kim **yoqib qoldirdi**?

sentences.text: **Turn** the hot tap **on** and let it run for a minute before you have a shower.
sentences.translation: Issiq suv jo'mragini **och** va dushga tushishdan oldin bir daqiqa oqib tursin.

sentences.text: In our office the air conditioning **comes on** by itself as soon as it gets hot.
sentences.translation: Ofisimizda havo isishi bilan konditsioner o'zi **yoqiladi**.

sentences.text: Halfway through the film, the electricity **went off** across the whole village.
sentences.translation: Filmning yarmida butun qishloqda elektr **o'chib qoldi**.

sentences.text: Our internet was **cut off** because Jasur forgot to pay the bill.
sentences.translation: Jasur to'lovni unutgani uchun internetimizni **uzib qo'yishdi**.

sentences.text: Could you **put** some music **on**? It's far too quiet in here.
sentences.translation: Biror musiqa **qo'yib yuborolasanmi**? Bu yer juda jimjit.

sentences.text: Please **switch off** all electronic devices before the plane takes off.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, samolyot ko'tarilishidan oldin barcha elektron qurilmalarni **o'chiring**.

sentences.text: We were discussing the contract on the phone when suddenly we got **cut off**.
sentences.translation: Telefonda shartnomani muhokama qilayotgan edik, to'satdan aloqa **uzilib qoldi**.

sentences.text: Is the oven still **on**? — No, I **turned** it **off** ten minutes ago.
sentences.translation: Duxovka hali ham **yoniqmi**? — Yo'q, o'n daqiqa oldin **o'chirib qo'ydim**.

examples.title: Clothes: **put on**, **have on**, **keep on**
examples.description: **put on** — kiymoq (harakat); **wear** / **have on** — kiyib yurmoq (holat); **keep on** — yechmasdan turmoq; **try on** — kiyib ko'rmoq; **take off** — yechmoq; **slip off** / **throw on** — sekin yechmoq / shosha-pisha kiymoq.

sentences.text: It's freezing in here — I think I'll **keep** my coat **on**.
sentences.translation: Bu yer muzlab ketgan — paltomni **yechmayman** shekilli.

sentences.text: Bekzod **had** a bright orange shirt **on**, so we found him easily in the crowd.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning **egnida** yorqin to'q sariq ko'ylak **bor edi**, shuning uchun uni olomon orasidan oson topdik.

sentences.text: **Put on** something warm — the wind on the hills is really strong.
sentences.translation: Issiqroq narsa **kiyib ol** — tepaliklarda shamol juda kuchli.

sentences.text: I **threw on** a jumper and ran downstairs to answer the door.
sentences.translation: Sviterni **shosha-pisha kiydim**-u, eshikni ochgani pastga yugurdim.

sentences.text: Do you mind if I **try on** the blue jacket as well?
sentences.translation: Ko'k kurtkani ham **kiyib ko'rsam** maylimi?

sentences.text: In Uzbek homes guests usually **take off** their shoes at the door.
sentences.translation: O'zbek xonadonlarida mehmonlar odatda poyabzalini eshik oldida **yechishadi**.

sentences.text: Why are you wearing sunglasses indoors? **Take** them **off**, please.
sentences.translation: Nega xonada quyosh ko'zoynagi taqib olgansiz? Iltimos, uni **olib qo'ying**.

sentences.text: She **slipped off** her heels under the table during the long dinner.
sentences.translation: Uzoq cho'zilgan kechki ovqat paytida u stol ostida poshnali tuflisini **sekin yechib qo'ydi**.

sentences.text: What was the thief wearing? — He **had** a black hoodie **on**.
sentences.translation: O'g'rining egnida nima bor edi? — U qora kapyushonli sviter **kiyib olgan edi**.

sentences.text: Kate **put on** her best dress, although she knew the party would be casual.
sentences.translation: Ziyofat oddiy bo'lishini bilsa ham, Keyt eng yaxshi ko'ylagini **kiydi**.

examples.title: More with **put on**: weight, shows and acts
examples.description: **put on weight** — semirmoq; **put on** a show / an exhibition / classes — tashkil qilmoq, sahnalashtirmoq; **put on** extra buses — qo'shimcha qo'ymoq; **put on** a brave face / a smile — o'zini ... ko'rsatmoq; **put it on** — o'zini biror holatga solmoq.

sentences.text: I've **put on** three kilos since I stopped going to the gym.
sentences.translation: Sport zaliga borishni to'xtatganimdan beri uch kilo **vazn qo'shdim**.

sentences.text: Doctors say that **putting on** a little weight in winter is quite normal.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlarning aytishicha, qishda biroz **vazn qo'shish** odatiy hol.

sentences.text: The students **put on** a play about Alisher Navoi at the end of the year.
sentences.translation: Yil yakunida talabalar Alisher Navoiy haqida spektakl **sahnalashtirishdi**.

sentences.text: The museum in Bukhara is **putting on** an exhibition of old Uzbek jewellery.
sentences.translation: Buxorodagi muzey qadimiy o'zbek taqinchoqlari ko'rgazmasini **tashkil qilyapti**.

sentences.text: Grandma was in pain, but she **put on** a brave face for the children.
sentences.translation: Buvimning joni og'riyotgan edi, lekin bolalar oldida **o'zini tetik ko'rsatdi**.

sentences.text: Is Jasur really ill, or is he just **putting it on** to miss the test?
sentences.translation: Jasur rostdan kasalmi yoki testdan qochish uchun **o'zini kasallikka solyaptimi**?

sentences.text: Our company **puts on** free English classes for staff every Wednesday.
sentences.translation: Kompaniyamiz har chorshanba xodimlar uchun bepul ingliz tili darslarini **tashkil qiladi**.

sentences.text: The extra buses **put on** for the festival were packed all day.
sentences.translation: Bayram uchun **qo'shimcha qo'yilgan** avtobuslar kun bo'yi odamga to'la bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Sarah **put on** a cheerful smile, although she was nervous about the results.
sentences.translation: Natijalardan xavotirda bo'lsa ham, Sara **o'zini quvnoq ko'rsatib** jilmaydi.

sentences.text: Bekzod **put on** so much weight after the wedding that his suits don't fit.
sentences.translation: Bekzod to'ydan keyin shunchalik **semirib ketdiki**, kostyumlari sig'maydi.

examples.title: Postponing: **put off** the meeting, **put off** going
examples.description: **put off** — keyinga qoldirmoq (+ ot yoki `-ing`; until / till); **keep putting off** — paysalga solmoq; **put sb off** — xohishini so'ndirmoq, ko'nglini aynitmoq; **be put off by** — biror narsadan cho'chib qolmoq.

sentences.text: We've **put off** the wedding until the autumn, when it's cooler.
sentences.translation: To'yni havo salqinroq bo'ladigan kuzgacha **qoldirdik**.

sentences.text: Stop **putting off** your homework — the deadline is tomorrow!
sentences.translation: Uy vazifangni **paysalga solishni** bas qil — muddat ertaga tugaydi!

sentences.text: Nilufar keeps **putting off** going to the dentist because she's scared.
sentences.translation: Nilufar qo'rqqani uchun tish shifokoriga borishni hadeb **orqaga suryapti**.

sentences.text: The meeting has been **put off** till next Tuesday because the director is ill.
sentences.translation: Direktor kasal bo'lgani uchun yig'ilish keyingi seshanbaga **qoldirildi**.

sentences.text: Can we **put** our dinner **off**? I've got to stay late at work.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqatimizni **boshqa kunga qoldirsak** bo'ladimi? Ishda kech qolishim kerak.

sentences.text: The smell of the fish market **put** me **off** eating fish for weeks.
sentences.translation: Baliq bozorining hidi bir necha hafta baliq yeyishdan **ko'nglimni aynitib qo'ydi**.

sentences.text: Don't be **put off** by the long queue — it moves very quickly.
sentences.translation: Uzun navbatdan **cho'chib qolmang** — u juda tez yuradi.

sentences.text: What **put** you **off** studying medicine? — The long hours, mainly.
sentences.translation: Sizni tibbiyot o'qishdan nima **sovutdi**? — Asosan, uzoq ish soatlari.

sentences.text: Never **put off** until tomorrow what you can do today.
sentences.translation: Bugungi ishni ertaga **qoldirma**.

sentences.text: The loud music in the restaurant **put** our guests **off**, so we left early.
sentences.translation: Restorandagi baland musiqa mehmonlarimizning **ta'bini xira qildi**, shuning uchun erta ketdik.

examples.title: Cancelled or not? **call off**, **be off**, **go ahead**
examples.description: **call off** — bekor qilmoq (voqea umuman bo'lmaydi); **be off** — bekor qilingan; **be on** — kuchda; **go ahead** — rejadagidek o'tmoq. Solishtiring: **put off** — keyinroq bo'ladi.

sentences.text: The workers **called off** the strike after the company offered them more money.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya ko'proq pul taklif qilgach, ishchilar ish tashlashni **bekor qilishdi**.

sentences.text: The search for the missing climbers was **called off** when night fell.
sentences.translation: Qorong'i tushgach, bedarak yo'qolgan alpinistlarni qidirish **to'xtatildi**.

sentences.text: Is the barbecue still **on**, or has it been cancelled because of the rain?
sentences.translation: Mangal hali ham **bo'ladimi** yoki yomg'ir tufayli bekor qilindimi?

sentences.text: Bad news: the trip to Khiva **is off** — the bus company has gone bankrupt.
sentences.translation: Yomon xabar: Xivaga sayohat **bekor bo'ldi** — avtobus kompaniyasi bankrot bo'libdi.

sentences.text: Despite the snow, the concert **went ahead** as planned.
sentences.translation: Qorga qaramay, konsert rejadagidek **o'tkazildi**.

sentences.text: Emma and Oliver have **called off** their engagement, but they're still friends.
sentences.translation: Emma va Oliver unashtiruvni **buzishdi**, lekin hali ham do'st.

sentences.text: Should we **call** the football **off**? Half the team has the flu.
sentences.translation: Futbolni **bekor qilaylikmi**? Jamoaning yarmi grippda.

sentences.text: We didn't cancel the meeting — we just **put** it **off** for a week.
sentences.translation: Biz yig'ilishni bekor qilmadik — shunchaki bir haftaga **qoldirdik**.

sentences.text: The match is definitely **on** — the referee has already checked the pitch.
sentences.translation: O'yin aniq **bo'ladi** — hakam maydonni allaqachon tekshirib chiqdi.

sentences.text: If too few people sign up, the course will be **called off**.
sentences.translation: Agar juda kam odam yozilsa, kurs **bekor qilinadi**.

examples.title: Leaving: **set off**, **be off**, **drive off**
examples.description: **off** — joydan uzoqlashish: **set off** — yo'lga chiqmoq; **be off** — ketmoq (I'm off!); **head off** — jo'namoq; **drive off** / **walk off** / **run off** — haydab / yurib / yugurib ketib qolmoq; **move off** — joyidan qo'zg'almoq.

sentences.text: We **set off** before dawn so that we could reach Samarkand by lunchtime.
sentences.translation: Tushlikkacha Samarqandga yetib olish uchun tong otmasdan **yo'lga chiqdik**.

sentences.text: Right, I'm **off** — see you all on Monday!
sentences.translation: Xo'p, men **ketdim** — dushanba kuni ko'rishamiz!

sentences.text: Where are you **off** to in such a hurry?
sentences.translation: Bunchalik shoshilib qayoqqa **ketyapsan**?

sentences.text: The thief grabbed her bag and **ran off** towards the station.
sentences.translation: O'g'ri sumkasini yulib olib, vokzal tomon **qochib ketdi**.

sentences.text: James was so angry that he **walked off** in the middle of the meeting.
sentences.translation: Jeymsning jahli chiqqanidan yig'ilish o'rtasida **turib ketib qoldi**.

sentences.text: The driver didn't stop after the accident; he just **drove off**.
sentences.translation: Haydovchi avariyadan keyin to'xtamadi, shunchaki **haydab ketib qoldi**.

sentences.text: After lunch the tourists **headed off** to see the Registan.
sentences.translation: Tushlikdan keyin sayyohlar Registonni ko'rgani **jo'nashdi**.

sentences.text: What time should we **set off** if we want to miss the traffic in London?
sentences.translation: Londondagi tirbandlikka tushmaslik uchun soat nechada **yo'lga chiqishimiz** kerak?

sentences.text: The bus **moved off** before Madina had found a seat.
sentences.translation: Madina o'tirishga joy topmasidan avtobus **joyidan qo'zg'aldi**.

sentences.text: Our dog **runs off** whenever someone opens the gate, so we keep it locked.
sentences.translation: Kimdir darvozani ochsa, itimiz darhol **qochib qoladi**, shuning uchun uni qulflab qo'yamiz.

examples.title: Planes and days off: **take off**, **take a day off**
examples.description: **take off** — (samolyot) havoga ko'tarilmoq; **take** a day / a week **off** — ishdan javob olmoq, ta'til olmoq; **have** a day **off** — dam olish kuni bo'lmoq; **get off** (work) — ishdan chiqmoq; **knock off** (BrE, so'zlashuv) — ishni tugatmoq.

sentences.text: Fasten your seatbelts, please — we'll be **taking off** in a few minutes.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, kamarlaringizni taqing — bir necha daqiqadan keyin **havoga ko'tarilamiz**.

sentences.text: The plane **took off** smoothly, and soon we could see the whole of Tashkent below us.
sentences.translation: Samolyot ravon **ko'tarildi**, ko'p o'tmay pastda butun Toshkent ko'rindi.

sentences.text: I'm exhausted — I'm going to **take** next week **off** and stay at home.
sentences.translation: Holdan toydim — kelasi haftaga **ta'til olib**, uyda o'tiraman.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **took** three days **off** work to look after her sick son.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza kasal o'g'liga qarash uchun ishdan uch kunga **javob oldi**.

sentences.text: Do you **have** Friday **off**, or are you working this week?
sentences.translation: Juma kuni **dam olasizmi** yoki bu hafta ishlaysizmi?

sentences.text: What time do you **get off** work on Saturdays?
sentences.translation: Shanba kunlari ishdan soat nechada **chiqasiz**?

sentences.text: Let's **knock off** early today and go for a pizza.
sentences.translation: Bugun ishni erta **tugatib**, pitsa yegani boraylik.

sentences.text: Delays are common at Heathrow because so many planes **take off** and land every minute.
sentences.translation: Xitrouda kechikishlar tez-tez bo'ladi, chunki har daqiqada juda ko'p samolyot **ko'tariladi** va qo'nadi.

sentences.text: Since the baby was born, Tom hasn't **had** a single day **off**.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq tug'ilganidan beri Tom birorta ham **dam olish kuni ko'rmadi**.

sentences.text: Our flight was supposed to **take off** at nine, but we sat on the runway until eleven.
sentences.translation: Reysimiz soat to'qqizda **havoga ko'tarilishi** kerak edi, lekin uchish yo'lagida o'n birgacha o'tirdik.

examples.title: Dialogue: a holiday that almost didn't happen
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: er-xotin ta'tilga otlanmoqda — set off, put off, call off, take a week off, turn off, leave on, be on, put on, be off.

sentences.text: — Are we still **setting off** at seven tomorrow, or has something changed?
sentences.translation: — Ertaga baribir soat yettida **yo'lga chiqamizmi** yoki biror narsa o'zgardimi?

sentences.text: — Bad news, I'm afraid: the airline has **put off** our flight until the afternoon.
sentences.translation: — Afsuski, yomon xabar: aviakompaniya reysimizni tushdan keyinga **qoldiribdi**.

sentences.text: — At least they haven't **called** it **off**! I've already **taken** the whole week **off**.
sentences.translation: — Har qalay **bekor qilishmabdi**! Men allaqachon butun haftaga **ta'til olganman**.

sentences.text: — True. Should I **turn off** the water and the gas before we leave?
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri. Ketishdan oldin suv va gazni **o'chirib qo'yaymi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, but **leave** one light **on** in the hall, so the house doesn't look empty.
sentences.translation: — Ha, lekin dahlizda bitta chiroqni **yoqib qoldir**, uy bo'sh ko'rinmasin.

sentences.text: — Good idea. And is your sister's visit still **on** for next month?
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi fikr. Singlingning kelasi oydagi tashrifi hali ham **kuchdami**?

sentences.text: — Yes, unless her boss **calls off** her holiday again.
sentences.translation: — Ha, agar boshlig'i yana uning ta'tilini **bekor qilmasa**.

sentences.text: — Fingers crossed. Now **put on** something comfortable for the flight.
sentences.translation: — Omadini bersin. Endi parvoz uchun qulayroq biror narsa **kiyib ol**.

sentences.text: — I will. And don't let me **put off** packing until the last minute!
sentences.translation: — Xo'p. Narsalarni yig'ishni so'nggi daqiqaga **qoldirishimga** yo'l qo'yma!

sentences.text: — Too late — you already have! Right, I'm **off** to the shop for some snacks.
sentences.translation: — Kech — allaqachon qoldirding! Xo'p, men yegulik olgani do'konga **ketdim**.
